melee.ammo_basis: Wiki Melee Weapons: held attack can continue when stamina is empty

medium_weakpoints.policy: Compare evidenced lethal front/head/body routes by measured response; precise mouths and broad explosive saturation have different acquisition costs.
medium_weakpoints.cost_basis: All precise-part routes pay acquisition cost regardless of weapon penetration. Twofold is a provisional engineering value for ordinary head/gap aim; no hit probability, damage or ammunition penalty.
medium_weakpoints.precise_minimum_basis: User requires at least fourfold acquisition time for Bile Spewer specific-part aim, with a higher fivefold minimum for its mouth. Broad explosive abdomen saturation is not precise-part aim.

user_checks.statement: User confirms all non-Main parts are explosion-immune and usual Scorcher consumption is six to eight shots. This is a validation range, not a damage override or instant threat-removal claim.

bile_spewer:head.evidence: Large unarmored fatal abdomen is visible from front/side/rear and has 100 percent durability but 0 percent ExDR. User confirms broad explosive saturation is a practical fast route. This is not a promise that every armor plate has identical BTK.

alpha_commander:head.evidence: Main is listed as a front/side damage zone with AV2, 70 percent durability and no constitution. Compare direct body destruction against head break plus residual bleed; never force waiting when the same weapon has a quicker body route.

hive_guard:head.evidence: Wiki tactics explicitly describes hitting Main through the frontal gap, including while crouched; Main has 0 percent ExDR.

bile_spewer:head.cost_basis: User-specified minimum of fivefold precise-mouth acquisition time; this is a time cost, not measured accuracy.
bile_spewer:head.evidence: Wiki describes the unarmored mouth as optimal for light penetration; it is fatal with 100 percent ExDR. Redirected blast damage to Main is not counted as mouth damage.

medium_resolution.overflow_basis: Conservative default: same-hit excess is not deducted from constitution without confirmed event ordering. Main transfer remains independent. The review also computes overflow-enabled sensitivity.

gas_control.basis: User confirms S11 gas confusion leaves the decapitated commander with little practical threat. 300 ms response delay and 10 percent residual threat are engineering estimates, not hit probability or guaranteed hard stun. Only direct status delivery is credited here.

S-11_P:alpha_commander:head.basis: User-confirmed S11 commander overpenetration route; head-to-Main alignment and Wiki one-AP cost are explicit engineering inputs, not a universal pass-through rule.
S-11_P:alpha_commander:head.source_conflict: Wiki describes one AP lost per cleave. OTL's 6.3.0 code study describes an armor/durability cost and is older than current 7.2.1. This route is evaluated alongside a zero-extra-hit sensitivity; no generic AP+2 rule is enabled.

medium_resolution.scope: One weapon, explicit selected part and at most one bound follow-through part. Gas damages Main only; confusion changes residual threat, never HP. Natural bleed and control do not occupy the player's hands.

assumptions: 28轻/8中为用户40怪构成的非重甲部分；具体物种分配为常见组合工程样本
